notes.title: PLAYTEST UPDATE 2024/04
notes.content:
STEERING WHEEL SUPPORT
- Enable Steering Wheel using Direct Input option, else the inputs will be eased as a gamepad! Or via dev menu.
- Tested with G25. If your steering wheel supports Direct Input should also work. You can remap it in the options. CHANGES WON`T YET BE SAVED.
-Let me know if your steering wheel works or not! I can create custom mappings for your steerings if you provide me with the Direct Input readings that show up in the menu. Notice that G25 clutch pedal constantly inputs a value, hence to avoid this there is an opion to mute that axis. Despit that Direct Input plugin may not display other axes unless that axis is in the 0 range.

FORCE FEEDBACK
-Enable/dissable and set the force ammount in Options menu. Requires Direct Input enabled.

SHIFTER SUPPORT
-Paddles, sequential and H-box support (H-requires clutch usage, let me know if clutchless would be a desired feature).
-Tested with G25 shifter, Other shifters could be preset if you provide me with the input listener values in the menu. I'll add input mapping in the future.

TUNE MANAGER
- Save/Load every parameter of the car setup. Wether it is from the Mod or Tune menu. You can save all the setup in one click into the currently loaded tune, save to a custom named tune or even save just a set of parameters to create a subset like different suspension setups within a tune.

MISC
- Handbrake automatically handles clutch not to kill engine
- Gamepad easing and assist reworked and tuned.
-Added to the menu the missingn car setup parameters (engine torque curve & aerodynamics)
- backgroudn previuew. The data IS NOT YET OPTIMIZED, hence I dissabled as default. But you can have a glimpse into how it will look.


FUTURE AND ONGOING WORK
- Mesh and texture streaming for improved performanced, this would solve game no longer working on Steam Deck.
- Mesh virtualization and point data rendering as streamed mesh vertex could lead into a continous road network. For now I'm working the sections separatelly.
- Car creation tool.
- AI
- More touges
- Discord soon.


PD: This news, somehow got posted on the game's main page, reposting it here. 
I did read the comment about the clutch on the othe logitech wheel, I got nuts until I realized the source of that data stream.

notes.title: PLAYTEST UPDATE - LAST OF 2023
notes.content:
What better than to update the playtest to finish the year.

v 0.2c



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44222072/f775baf8ea17dc68796bc14cf61a4e67d3b84bf8.jpg


FULL TOUGE IS NOW PLAYABLE
-From sea level up to Nishina pass, 12Km i total.

OPTIMIZATIONS 
- The mesh that is combined with the scan data has been largely optimized. The HD mesh is also available, which I recommend to use without scan data as else interferes a bit with it. The scan data has ben thinned further.

CAR FLIP BUG FIXED !!
-Finally found the issue...

CAR SETUP FINE TUNED
-Should feel more grounded, in future you'll be able to tune it as you like. I may create a more drifty setup in the meantime.

NEW VISUAL MODES
-Legacy mode 1 kept yet I did add some variants.

A LOT OF SMALL TWEAKS AND ADDITIONS



There as some details pending to be polished, yet I though it was mroe than enough for a update considering how much was piling up.

PENDING:
SOME BUILDINGS HAVE NO COLOR
ROAD TEXTURE FIX ON NEW SECTION
BACKGROUND
NO GUARDRAIL COLLIDER IN NEW SECTION

Have fun.




PLEASE WISHLIST THE GAME IF YOU LIKE IT.

notes.title: PLAYTEST UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello,

V0.2b brings a major track extension. The touge gets quite technical once we pass the original Playtest layout, and the forgiving wide road is no longer there, demanding the best from you.

https://i.postimg.cc/XJh1nW8J/Image-117.png


I've increased the grip of the tires so you can handle with more precision. Car tweaking will become relevant in the v0.3x phase.

Map loading should now be much faster.

Overall performance should be fine, as I've tested it extensively, including on the SteamDeck (where it's not yet playable with scan data enabled).

There are a number of small tweaks.

Still pending:

-Background
-Road texturing fix.
Can't wait to hear the feedback.

Best regards,

Pablo.
